goal: Move the Owner-approved Big 3 fragments, Moon-in-house texts and 72 topic placements from docs/content-review into packages/content and show them: Big 3 headline and summary on the hub and chart overview, the Mặt Trăng hôm nay block on the hub, and Tổng quan / Tình yêu / Sự nghiệp / Bản thân tabs on the chart overview. Unify the point names to Thiên đỉnh and Cung mọc.
successCriteria: packages/content/data/astrology-big3.json, astrology-moon-houses.json and astrology-topic-placements.json hold the approved text with house 6 renamed to nhịp sống hằng ngày, and validate:data checks their coverage.

Hub shows the Big 3 headline and summary; the Today block shows only when the birth time is exact; without an exact time the Rising line and Today block are hidden and an invite to add the birth time is shown.

Chart overview has Tổng quan plus three topic tabs with two placements each, a one-line reminder at the end of each tab, a birth-time note on Bản thân, and one placement plus the invite when a point needs a birth time.
The app writes Thiên đỉnh and Cung mọc everywhere on screen.
npm --workspace apps/mobile run check, the mobile Jest suite and validate:data pass, and a 390x844 web walkthrough covers hub and chart tabs.
untouchedSurfaces: Edge Functions, prompts, entitlements and database are unchanged; ai-astrology-report keeps its server wording until a separate deploy.
Synastry is not built in this task.
Tarot, Home, Journal and Chat screens.
